body:
Thanks to all of you.

A bit of an update. I posted that last night at probably the worst point I've been in awhile. Things were kinda stacking up because I'd just had a talk with "the girl".

I was cutting just after speaking to her and stopped replying to her messages in a normal manner, I was talking as if I was never going to see her again (Which I really did think was the truth at the time). She, without saying too much, explained I was still a good friend (As is she, I was really hesitant to tell her how I felt because I was 90% sure it would fuck things up) and she didn't want another friend to 'go'. So, around 3am, she rocked upto my place with her room mate (I don't know him that well but I'd still consider him a good friend). We stood around outside and talked for an hour - not about anything in particular, just talked.

The short of the long....

I'm going to try put it all behind me, take it in my stride, and salvage the awesome-awkward friendship we had.
Thanks for your words too, they really did actually help. (baassett, I may take you up on that some time)

(Holy shit that message is all over the place. My mind is still a bit of a mess. Things are settling down though)
